view: top-down plan of the street (author, Desk zx7u-q1)
units: real metres (the exterior world is in real metres; the diorama is scaled by 1/PAINT_SCALE)
transform: px = (x + 12.5) * 100, py = (z + 12.5) * 100; +X right, -Z (behind the building) up, so the camera side of the street is at the bottom
origin: centre of the front wall base (x 0, z 0)

classes.0: a bro standing here is fully visible

meaning: Seen from above: for every walkable floor point, how much of a bro standing there the follow camera cannot see. Rays go from the bro's centre line at 5 heights to the camera; anything solid in between hides that height. Blocked floor is 0 (no bro stands there). The footprints of the things that hide the bros are in aa_mask_exterior_occlusion_ids.png.

camera.rule: the Phantom Camera follows the leader at a fixed offset (_build_camera), so the ray from the leader to the camera has one direction everywhere. Computed for the leader; the two followers stand a step behind and use the leader's camera. Follow damping is ignored.

bro.width: centre line only (sprite width not added)

not_modelled.door leaves: no door-leaf geometry in the exterior code (the doorway is a relief recess on aa_face_front; doors are bead d4i6)
not_modelled.flyer panel: flat overlay cards 0.06 painting units off the front face: they cannot stand between a bro and the camera
not_modelled.wifi hotspot / examine points: markers and a hidden Label3D only, no visible mesh
